title: Italian-Style Kisir Salad
description: A twist on traditional Turkish kisir, this Italian-inspired salad combines the flavors of Italy with the spice of Turkish cuisine. Crunchy bulgur and fresh vegetables come together in a delicious and healthy dish.
instructions: Cook the bulgur according to package instructions.
Chop the tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and fresh parsley.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked bulgur, chopped vegetables, and minced garlic.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, Turkish pepper, and salt.
Pour the dressing over the bulgur mixture and toss to combine.
Season with additional salt and pepper to taste.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
